label: preparing
what: A privately funded celebration or surprise marking the mayor's forty years of service, in the great hall on day 1 at eighteen. Innkeeper is coordinating delivery before seventeen and checking private payment; arrangements include two hundred loaves and eight installed lanterns. Secretary records and secures confirmations, freight confirms scheduling, and builder discusses the order with innkeeper. The mayor knows of the invitation and suspects its purpose, but has not been told the full details.
